s: Dine qiddush sheal hayyayin ubo l' seipim: mitzvat aseh min hattora leqaddesh et yom hashshabbat bidbarim, shenneemar "zakor et yom hashshabbat leqaddesho", kelomar zakerehu zekirot shebach veqiddush. Vetzarik lezakerehu biknisato ubitziato, biknisato — beqiddush hayyom, ubitziato — behabdala. Veyesh omerim shehabdala enah ella middibre soperim, umin hattora en tzarik lezakerehu ella biknisato bilbad, veyitbaer besimman rtz"v:

Vetiqqenu chakamim shettehe zekira zo al kos shel yayin, ben biknisato, ben bitziato. Umitzva min hammubchar leqaddesh samuk litchillat kenisato bekol mah sheepshar. Veap im yatza mibbet hakkeneset mibbeod yom — yesh lo leqaddesh miyyad, dekevan shehosip mechol al haqqodesh — hare zeh etzlo kenisat hashshabbat, veyesh lo leqaddesh miyyad samuk liknisato. Veachar haqqiddush tzarik leekol gam ken miyyad, kede sheyyihyeh haqqiddush bimqom seudda. Veim eno taeb leekol miyyad — yakol lehamtin milleqaddesh tok hallayla kamma sheyyirtzeh, kede sheyyokal leteabon, veyukal lismok al mah shekkebar zekaro bitchillat kenisato bitpillat arbit, shekkebar yatza bazeh min hattora, shehare min hattora en tzarik ella zekira bidbarim bilbad belo yayin, vahare zekaro bitpilla:

Yesh nizharim shello leqaddesh beshaa rishona shel hallayla (dehaynu shaa shebiit achar chatzot hayyom, ayyen simman tk"ch), ella o qodem hallayla, o leachar shaa tok hallayla, lepi shebbeshaa harishona hu mazzal madim, vesama"l moshel alayv. Ukebar nitbaer shellekatchilla yesh lo leqaddesh miyyad beboo mibbet hakkeneset mibbeod yom:

Haqqiddush beyom tob hu middibre soperim, veap al pi ken yesh lo kol dine qiddush shel shabbat lekol dabar. Ella sheim en lo ella kos echad vechal yom tob beereb shabbat — hare qiddush shel shabbat qodem leshel yom tob, kevan sheiqqar haqqiddush beshabbat hu min hattora, ap al pi sheal hakkos hu middibre soperim:

Nashim chayyabot beqiddush hayyom beshabbat min hattora, ubeyom tob middibre soperim. Veap al pi shekkol mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot mimmenna — beqiddush hayyom chayyabot, shenneemar "zakor et yom vego'", veneemar "shamor et yom vego'", kol sheyyeshno bishmira yeshno bizkira, vehoil vehannashim muzharot bishmirato lehishshamer bo measiyyat melaka, shehi mitzvat "lo taaseh kol melaka vego'", vekol mitzvat lo taaseh ap shehazzeman gerama nashim muzharot bah — hare hen muzharot gam ken bizkirato, dehaynu qiddush hayyom:

Vekevan shehannashim chayyabot beqiddush hayyom min hattora kemo haanashim — yekolot lehotzi et haanashim yede chobatam, ella shellekattechilla en lehorot ken leshoel halaka lemaaseh (shello yabou lezalzel bemitzvot):

Veqatan apillu hu ben y"g shana, im eno yadua shehebi b' searot — eno motzi et haishsha, kevan shehi mechuyyebet min hattora bevadday vehu eno mechuyyab ella missapeq, ki shemma lo hebi b' searot adayin, vehu patur mikkol hammitzvot min hattora, laken teqaddesh haishsha beatzmah. Veim enah yodaat — tomar im haqqatan milla bemilla. Vaapillu im shomaat haqqiddush miggadol, mikkol maqom im enah mebina leshon haqqodesh — tomar immo milla bemilla, kemo shennitbaer besimman qtz"g:

Mi sheen yado masseget liqnot yayin leqiddush shebballayla, ulehakin tzorke seudda likbod hallayla velikbod hayyom, veyayin leqiddush shebbayyom — hare qiddush hallayla qodem lakkol, lepi shehu min hattora. Ap al pi sheyyakol leqaddesh al happat, vegam al hayyayin eno ella middibre soperim, mikkol maqom kevan sheiqqar qiddush zeh hu min hattora — gam hayyayin shello qodem lakkol. Chutz min happat, sheim en lo pat lechem mishneh — hi qodemet leyayin shel qiddush hallayla, viqaddesh al happat, lepi shehappat hu iqqar mitzvat seuddat hashshabbat, shei epshar leqayyeman kelal belo pat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"d. Veim yesh lo pat veyayin leqiddush hallayla, vetzarik (liqnot yayin leqiddush shebbayyom) ulehakin tzorke seudda likbod layla velikbod yom — hare tzorke seudda shellikbod hayyom qodemin (leqiddush hayyom) uletzorke seudda shelikbod hallayla, shekkebod yom qodem likbod layla. Veken mi sheyyesh lo meat mine megadim — yannichem ad hayyom velo yoklem ballayla, shekkebod hayyom qodem (veken qiddush shebbayyom qodem letzorke seudda shelikbod hallayla):

Aseru chakamim litom kelum, apillu mayim, mishshehiggia zeman haqqiddush ad sheyyeqaddesh, dehaynu mishshehiggia ben hashshemashot shennitqaddesh hayyom missapeq, o apillu mibbeod yom, im hitpallel arbit mibbeod yom. Veap al pi shekkol mitzvot haqqabua lahem zeman lo aseru ella liqboa seudda mishshehiggia zemannan, mishshum gezera shemma yimmashek basseudda veyaabor hazzeman, abal teima bealma muttar, sheen lachush bah shemma yimmashek veyaabor hazzeman, mikkol maqom beqiddush, veken behabdala, hechemiru yoter, lepi sheiqqar mitzvatan hu bitchillat zemannam, dehaynu samuk liknisat hashshabbat vesamuk litziato. Vaapillu im hitchil leekol velishtot mibbeod yom — tzarik lehapsiq kesheyyaggia ben hashshemashot. Veap al pi shebbishar kol hammitzvot, apillu shel tora, im hitchil behetter, dehaynu qodem shehiggia hammitzva — en tzarik lehapsiq, umittaam zeh gam ken en tzarik lehapsiq liqriat shema velitpilla kesheyyaggia zemannan, mikkol maqom beqiddush hayyom lo hittiru lo ligmor seuddato uleqaddesh achar kak, lepi sheiqqar haqqiddush nitqan bimqom seudda shel shabbat, veqodem lah, velo leachareha, shenneemar "veqarata lashshabbat oneg", vedareshu chakamim: bimqom oneg, dehaynu bemaqom sheyyitanneg sham bisuddat shabbat — sham tehe qeriat haqqiddush millepaneha. Umikkol maqom, en lo lehapsiq seuddato legamre ulebarek birkat hammazon, mittaam sheyyitbaer, ella yeqaddesh miyyad veyigmor seuddato, kede sheyyehe haqqiddush bimqom seudda shelleacharayv:
Vetzarik lipros mappa al hashshulchan lekassot happat qodem sheyyeqaddesh veachar kak yesirenna, kede shettitraeh happat keillu hubea atta al hashshulchan likbod shabbat shehizkir baqqiddush:

Veen tzarik lebarek "bore peri haggapen" al kos shel qiddush zeh im kebar berak al hayyayin bisudda zo, sheggam yayin zeh shel qiddush niptar beotah beraka, vegam al hayyayin sheshshoteh betok hammazon shelleachar haqqiddush en tzarik lebarek mittaam zeh. Veken im meqaddesh al happat — en tzarik lebarek aleha "hammotzi", ella yatchil mibbirkat haqqiddush. Abal im qiddesh al hakkos — tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" al pat sheyyokal achar haqqiddush, hoil ubishat amirat haqqiddush i epshar lo litom kelum, shei epshar lo leekol uledabber keechad. Veeno domeh lemitpallel beemtza seuddato sheen tepillato chashuba hepseq lehatino lachazor ulebarek "hammotzi" al pat sheyyokal achar kak, lepi sheadayin lo nigmera seuddato, kevan shello haya asur baakila beshaa shehitpallel, veim haya rotzeh haya okel beshaa shehitpallel vehaya mitpallel achar kak. Vaapillu im lo haya shahut bayyom ligmor seuddato ulehitpallel achar kak shechayyab hu lehapsiq seuddato ulehitpallel, veasur lo leekol od, mikkol maqom lo neesar alayv ella akilat qeba, shemma yimmashek bah veyaabor zeman hattepilla, abal teima bealma hayeta mutteret lo beshaa shehitpallel, ulepikak en tepillato chashuba hepseq basseudda. (Veod shello neesra alayv akila ella mippene shehiggia zeman hattepilla veachar kak chozer liqbiuto harishona, abal kan neesra alayv haakila kede sheyyehe haqqiddush lipne haakila velo leachareha kemo shennitbaer, im ken hare haqqiddush mechalleq shette haakilot, shekkesheokel achar kak hi nechshebet seudda acheret). Miyyad shehiggia zeman haqqiddush neesar alayv apillu teima bealma, venaasa keillu nigmera kebar seudato, lekak chashuba amirat haqqiddush hepseq, kevan shebbishat amirato lo haya yakol leekol kelum, vehu amaro achar gemar seuddato. Abal hayyayin shel qiddush ap al pi sheshshotehu achar qiddush — en tzarik lebarek alayv, kevan shezzeman birkato hu qodem amirat haqqiddush, veaz adayin en sham amira mapseqet. Veap lehaomerim shettaqqanat chakamim hu beqiddush vekol dabar hattaun kos sheyyebareku alayv birkat hayyayin techilla kemo shennitbaer besimman q"tz — moelet beraka harishona leqiddush kemo shemmoelet lebirkat hannehenin sheen tzarik lachazor ulebarek, hoil ubeshaa shehi chashuba gemar vesilluq seudda mippene issur hatteima qodem qiddush lo hayeta adayin amira hammapseqet, velo nistalleqa adayin beraka harishona, ubishat amirat haqqiddush hare dato al hakkos shebbeyado lishtoto miyyad, vaamirat haqqiddush hi letzorek hashshetiyya veenah chashuba hepseq lezeh, kemo sheenah chashuba hepseq lekol meqaddesh al hakkos. Mah sheen ken bappat, sheokel leachar sheqqiddesh al hakkos, shebbishat amirat haqqiddush hu keqodem amirato, shehayeta sheat gemar vesilluq seudda. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shemmah shenneesar alayv haakila mishshehiggia zeman haqqiddush — en zeh nechshab gemar hasseudda, kevan shebbedato leekol achar kak, vegam akshav haya okel middato ella shechiyyub haqqiddush monea oto, ukesheyyasur hammonea, dehaynu achar sheyyeqaddesh, yachazor laakilato, lepikak en amirat haqqiddush mapseqet kemo sheen hattepilla mapseqet, veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek hammotzi. Usepeq berakot lehaqel. Umikkol maqom, kol baal nepesh yesh lo lizzaher lekattechilla shello labo lide kak, veyapsiq seuddato vibarek birkat hammazon qodem sheyyaggia zeman qiddush hayyom:

Vekol zeh keshello amar adayin "tenu lanu hakkos unebarek birkat hammazon", abal im amar ken kebar, ben sheamar ken qodem zeman haqqiddush ben achar shehiggia zemanno — tzarik hu lebarek "bore peri haggapen" al kos shel qiddush, shehare hissiach dato mishshetiyya mechamat birkat hammazon. Abal im meqadesh al happat — en tzarik lebarek aleha "hammotzi". Veken apillu im qiddesh al hakkos — en tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" al happat sheokel achar haqqiddush, lepi sheamirat "tenu lanu unebarek" enah chashuba hessach haddaat leinyan akila ella leinyan shetiyya bilbad, kemo shennitbaer besimman qa"t. Abal im natal kebar yadayv bemayim acharonim — tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" apillu al happat shemmeqaddesh aleha, vekol shekken sheim qiddesh al hakkos shetztzarik lebarek "hammotzi" al happat sheokel achar kak, shennetilat mayim acharonim chashuba hessach haddaat gam leinyan akila, kemo shennitbaer sham. Veap shellekattechilla tob shello leekol velishtot kelal achar netilat mayim acharonim, ap al pi shemmebarek al akilato ushetiyyato, veachar kak qodem birkat hammazon yachazor veyittol mayim acharonim kemo shennitbaer sham, mikkol maqom kan yoter tob sheyyeqaddesh miyyad veyokal meat acharayv, kede sheyyehe haqqiddush bimqom seuddat shabbat shelleacharayv, mimmah sheyyebarek birkat hammazon miyyad viqaddesh achar kak, mippene sheim yaaseh ken yikkanes bemachaloqot rabbot, sheyyesh omerim sheyyebarek "bore peri haggapen" al kos birkat hammazon veyitamennu, velo yebarek shub "bore peri haggapen" al kos shel qiddush, shekkebar niptar bibraka zo. Veyesh omerim shello yitom kelum mikkos shel birkat hammazon, shehare lo qiddesh adayin, ulepikak lo yebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen", ella yannichennu ad leachar sheyyitom mikkos shel qiddush, veaz yitom gam ken mimmennu, vei epshar lo latzet yede shenehem, sheyyeqaddesh oto al oto kos atzmo shebberak alayv birkat hammazon, lepi shebbirkat hammazon hi qedushsha bipne atzmah, vehaqqiddush hu mitzva bipne atzmo, veen omerim b' qedushshot al kos achat, sheen osin mitzvot chabilot chabilot. Veap im hu meseb yechidi umebarek birkat hammazon belo kos, mikkol maqom im yeqaddesh miyyad achar birkat hammazon — yesh omerim sheeno yotze yede chobato ella im ken yachazor veyokal miyyad, sheyyehe haqqiddush bimqom seuddat shabbat shelleacharayv, veim ken mah shebberak birkat hammazon hi beraka sheenah tzerika, shehare haya yakol lippater bebirkat hammazon sheyyebarek achar akila hashsheniyya. Veap sheyyesh omerim sheen tzarik lachazor veleekol, lepi shebbediabad yukal lismok al seudda sheakal kebar shekkesheyyeqadesh achareha miyyad — hare zeh qiddush bimqom seudda ap al pi shehi seuddat hachol, mikkol maqom kede lachush lassebara harishona tzarik lizzaher shello labo lide kak. Ella ap al pi shennatal mayim acharonim yipros mappa viqaddesh, veyachazor veyokal meat kede sheyyehe haqqiddush bimqom seuddat shabbat shelleacharayv, veachar kak yachazor veyittol mayim acharonim vibarek birkat hammazon. Vekol shekken im lo natal yadayv adayin shetztzarik laasot ken, ap al pi shekkebar gamar seuddato mibbeod yom, ella shello hispiq lebarek birkat hammazon ad shehiggia zeman haqqiddush:

Veim abar vehitchil lebarek achar shehiggia zeman haqqiddush, apillu hitchil lebarek mishshechasheka — lo yazkir shel shabbat bebirkat hammazon, dekevan shemmebarek al hasseudda sheggamar bechol mibbeod yom, haek yazkir bah shel shabbat. Abal im mashak seuddato ad tok hallayla, ap al pi sheeno rashshay — tzarik lehazkir shel shabbat bebirkat hammazon ap al pi sheadayin lo qiddesh, shekkebar chala alayv qedushshat shabbat meeleha. (Veen tzarik lomar sheim peras mappa veqiddesh vegamar seuddato, shetztzarik lehazkir shel shabbat bebirkat hammazon, apillu im hechemir uperas mappa veqiddesh mibbeod yom qodem shehiggia zeman haqqiddush, vegam mebarek birkat hammazon mibbeod yom, dekevan sheqqiddesh — chala alayv qedushshat shabbat):

Shenayim shehayu shotin achar gemar hasseudda mibbeod yom veameru "bo uneqaddesh qiddush hayyom", ap al pi shello higgia adayin zeman haqqiddush — neesar alehem lishtot ad sheyyeqaddeshu. Veim rotzim lachazor velishtot, ap al pi sheenam rashshaim — tzerikim hem lachazor ulebarek "bore peri haggapen", shekkevan sheameru leqaddesh — hissichu datam mishshetiyya ad sheyyeqaddeshu. Abal im meqaddeshim miyyad — enam tzerikim lebarek al kos shel qiddush kemo shennitbaer lemala, shehare baamira zo lo hissichu datam mikkos shel qiddush:

Ap al pi sheasur litom qodem qiddush, im shakach, o abar, vetaam, apillu akal seudda gemura — tzarik leqaddesh miyyad shennizkar, veasur lo litom kelum mishshennizkar ad sheyyeqaddesh. Velo yebarek "bore peri haggapen" al kos shel qiddush im berak kebar al yayin. Veken im meqaddesh al happat — en tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" im berak kebar. Veap im meqaddesh al hakkos — en tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" al happat sheokel achar kak, kemo shennitbaer lemala. (Veim nizkar achar sheggamar seuddato — en tzarik leekol od achar haqqiddush kede sheyyehe haqqiddush bimqom seuddat shabbat shelleacharayv, dekevan sheakal hasseudda mishshechasheka achar shenniknas hashshabbat — hare hi niqret seuddat shabbat, ukeshemqaddesh achareha — hare qiddesh bimqom seuddat shabbat). Veim nizkar achar shebberak "hammotzi" qodem shettaam perusat "hammotzi" — lo yeqaddesh al hayyayin veyitztarek litom mehappat qodem qiddush kede shello tehe birkat "hammotzi" lebattala, ella yeqaddesh al happat. Veap im en lepanayv lechem mishneh vetzarik lehamtin ad sheyyabiu lepanayv — en zeh hepseq. Veap im yitztarek ledabber velomar lahem sheyyabiu lo — en zeh hepseq kelal, kevan shehu letzorek hasseudda, ukemo shennitbaer besimman qs"z:

Ap al pi shemmitzva min hammubchar leqaddesh samuk liknisat hashshabbat, mikkol maqom nimshak iqqar mitzvato kol hallayla. Veim shakach, o abar, velo qiddesh ballayla — yesh lo tashlumin lemachar kol hayyom. Veyomar kol haqqiddush shel layla, millebad parashat "vaykullu" sheeno inyan leomrah bayyom, lepi shebballayla hayeta gemar melakto shel haqqadosh baruk hu:

Ap al pi shehashshulchan tzarik lihyot aruk umesuddar mibbeod yom kemo shennitbaer besimman r[s]"b, mikkol maqom en mebiim oto limqom hasseudda ad achar haqqiddush, kede sheyyehe nikkar shebba likbod shabbat. Veim hebio qodem qiddush — tzarik lipros alayv mappa lekassoto keillu eno kan ad achar qiddush, kede sheyyitraeh keillu huba atta likbod shabbat. Bameh debarim amurim? Bimehem, shehayu lahem shulchanot qetannim kol echad shulchano lepanayv, velo haya lahem torach lehapsiq velahabiam achar qiddush, abal akshav sheshshulchanot shellanu gedolim, vetorach lahabio achar haqqiddush ulehapsiq ben qiddush lisudda — nohagin lahabio lekattechilla qodem qiddush velipros mappa lekassot happat ad achar haqqiddush, ben shemmeqaddesh al hayyayin, ben shemmeqaddesh al happat. Vetzarik shettehe gam mappa tachat happat al hashshulchan, kede shettehe happat ben shette mappot, zeker lamman shehaya alayv tal milmala vetal millematta:

Kos shel qiddush, ben shel layla ben shel yom, uben shel habdala, taun kol haddebarim shettaun kos shel birkat hammazon, sheyyihyeh shalem, vesheyyishtepennu mibbachutz, vidichennu mibbipnim, veyihyeh male yayin al kol gedotayv, velo yihyeh hayyayin pagum, viqabbelennu bishte yadayv, veyyochazennu bimino lebaddo, veyagbihennu meal hashshulchan tepach, veyitten enayv bo shello yassiach dato mimmennu, kemo shennitbaer besimman qp"g:

Ap al pi sheamar "vaykullu" bebet hakkeneset — tzarik lachazor uleomro al hakkos qodem qiddush, kede lehotzi banayv ubene beto haqqetannim shello amaruhu adayin, veachar kak yebarek "bore peri haggapen" ubirkat qiddush. Veim shakach leomro qodem qiddush — omero betok hasseudda al hakkos. Vetob laamod bishat amirat "vaykullu", mittaam shennitbaer besimman rs"ch. Abal bishat birkat haqqiddush yoter tob lesheb (mittaam shennitbaer besimman rtz"v). Abal bimdinot ellu nitpashshet hamminhag lesheb ap bishat amirat parashat "vaykullu", ki meachar sheamaruha kebar bebet hakkeneset meummad — en maqpidin kol kak laamod beshaa sheomerah lehotzi banayv ubene beto. Umikkol maqom, omedim qetzat keshemmatchilin "yom hashshishshi vaykullu hashshamayim", shennirmaz hashshem berashe tebot. Ukeshemmatchilin tob litten enayv bannerot, ki b' peamim ner oleh t"q, vehi repua lipsia gassa shennotelet echad mit"q mimmeor enayv shel adam. Abal bishat birkat haqqiddush tzarik litten enayv bakkos, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Mi sheen lo yayin leqiddush shel layla veshel yom ella kos achat, veim yechalleqennu leb' kosot lo yihyu meleim (o apillu im kos zeh eno male, ella sheim yechalleqennu leb' kosot lo yihyeh rebiit yayin bekol achat) — yannichennu kullo bekos achat viqaddesh alayv ballayla, ukede shello yihyeh kullo pagum kesheyyitam bo akshav mikkullo — yishpok mimmennu meat likli acher qodem sheyyitamennu, vihe nizhar sheyyehe nishar bekos zeh rebiit, kede sheyyitom merebiit, sheen kos shel beraka pachot merebiit, veachar kak yachazir letoko mah shebbakkeli haacher, ubazeh hu metuqqan mippegimato, kemo shennitbaer besimman qp"b. (Veim kos zeh eno male gam akshav, ella sheim yechalleqennu leb' kosot lo yihyeh rebiit shelema bekol achat — yishpok mimmennu meat qodem qiddush, veachar sheyyitamennu yachazirennu letoko, velo yishpok mimmennu achar haqqiddush qodem hatteima (mippene shehu bizyon habberaka (ayyen simman rtz"v), kemo shennitbaer besimman r"v), vegam shello lehapsiq ben beraka litima bechinnam, kevan shello yihyeh hakkos male ap im lo yishpok mimmennu kelum qodem haqqiddush. Veim en lo ella rebiit yayin betzimtzum yayin sheeno mazug, o apillu yoter mashshehu ella sheen lo kishne rob rebiit meruvvachim, ukeshehu shoteh ballayla nechsar lo lemachar harbeh — yimzegennu lemachar bemayim ad sheyyaamod al rebiit. Vehu sheyyehe rauy lishtiyya bimziga zo beinyan sheyyehe rauy lebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen", kemo she[ni]tebbaer besimman r"d:

Vekol zeh kesheyyesh lo kos acher lehabdala, sheim lo ken mutab sheyyannichennu lehabdala viqaddesh al happat, mimmah sheyyeqaddesh alayv velo yihyeh lo al meh lehabdil, sheen mabdilim al happat. Umikkol maqom, im yesh lo shekar lehabdil alayv bemaqom shehashshekar hu "chamar medina" — lo yannichennu lehabdala. Vaapillu qiddush shel yom qodem lehabdala kesheepshar lehabdil al hashshekar shehu "chamar medina", lepi shebbeqiddush apillu shel yom yesh omerim sheen meqaddeshin al hashshekar ap al pi shehu "chamar medina", kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ar"b, ubehabdala hakkol modim shemmabdilim alayv. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyachid bebeto, abal bebet hakkeneset — habdala qodemet leqiddush, lepi shebbeqiddush shebbebet hakkeneset eno motzi shum adam yede chobato, vegam yesh choleqim umeararim al qiddush zeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"t, abal habdala hi mitzva ledibre hakkol lehotzi mi sheen lo yayin, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ratz"[h]:

Shelosha minnochale haolam habba, veechad mehem hammeshayyer yayin miqqiddush lehabdala, dehaynu sheyyesh lo meat yayin umonea shetiyyato bishbil habdala. Veyesh omerim dehaynu shemmeqaddesh ballayla al kos gadol, sheyyishtayyer beoto kos leqiddush shel yom ulehabdala, vitaqqen oto mippegimato kemo shennitbaer lemala, ubetok hasseudda shoteh yayin acher. Vetob linhog ken:

Achar sheqqiddesh al hakkos yittol yadayv lisudda vibarek "al netilat yadayim". Veim shakach venatal yadayv qodem qiddush — lo yeqaddesh al hayyayin ella al happat, lepi shebbintila zo gilla dato shehappat chabiba lo miyyayin, vetzarik leqaddesh al hechabib. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheapillu lekattechilla yakol littol yadayv qodem haqqiddush, veen haqqiddush mapsiq ben netilat yadayim lisudda, kevan shehu letzorek hasseudda. Vehaiqqar kassebara [haacharona]. Veken hamminhag pashut bimdinot ellu, lebad millel pesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ta"g. Umikkol maqom, mi sherotzeh lehachamir al atzmo shello littol ad achar haqqiddush — yapeh hu oseh, veen mochin beyado al sheober al hamminhag, ki yakol lomar eeseh kedibre hakkol. Uledibre hakkol asur limzog hakkos bechammin achar netilat yadayim, ki tzarik diqduq gadol shello yechsar velo yotir, vahare zeh hepseq vehessach haddaat. Ulekattechilla tob lizzaher sheapillu hashshepika bilbaddah mehaqqanqan lakkos tihyeh qodem netilat yadayim:

Hamqaddesh tzarik sheyyitom mehakkos kimlo lugmayv, velo melo lugmayv mammash, ella kol sheillu mesalleqo letzad echad bepiv veyeraeh melo lugmayv, vehu rubbo shel rebiit beadam benoni, vehaggadol lepi godlo tzarik sheyyihyeh kimlo lugmayv shello. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik yoter merebiit ap al pi sheadayin eno kimlo lugmayv:

Im lo taam hamqaddesh vetaam echad mehamsubbin, im taam kimlo lugmayv mammash — yatzeu kullam yede chobatan. Abal en shetiyyat shenayim mitztarepet limlo lugma, lepi shetztzarik sheyyehaneh echad mehem mishshetiyyat kos shel beraka, ubepachot mimmelo lugmayv enah niqret shetiyya shel hanaa. Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar sheyyitamu kullam mikkos shel beraka, abal en tzarik melo lugmayv lekullam. Ak mi sheyyesh lo yayin meat — mutab sheyyitom echad bilbad kashshiur, veyanniach hashshear lemachar leqiddush o lehabdala. Vehaggeonim soberim sheim lo taam hamqaddesh atzmo kimlo lugmayv — lo yatza ap al pi shettaamu hamsubbin kol echad kimlo lugmayv. Verauy lachush ledibrehem lekattechilla. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beqiddush, abal behabdala ubishar kol haddebarim hatteunim kos — modim haggeonim sheapillu lekattechilla day bitimat echad mehamsubbin kimlo lugmayv:

Qiddesh al hakkos veqodem shettaam hipsiq bedibbur — chozer umebarek "bore peri haggapen", veeno tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh. Abal im hissiach dato mishshetiyyat kos zeh, (o) sheyyatza mecheder zeh lecheder acher, ap al pi shechazar limqomo — tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh, veeno yotze yede chobato beqiddush harishon, kevan shehipsiq beno litimat hakkos behessach haddaat, (o) baaqirat maqom mecheder lecheder:

Veken im nishpak kos sheqqiddesh alayv — yabiu lo kos acher vibarek alayv "bore peri haggapen" im lo haya bedato lishtot od yayin achar haqqiddush, veen tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh im lo hissiach dato velo hipsiq baaqirat maqom benetayim. Veim qiddesh beshacharit al hashshekar venishpak hakkos (kevan shenapsho shel adam qatza beshekar beshacharit) — yesh lehaqel sheen tzarik lehabi kos acher lebarek alayv, shehare yesh omerim sheapillu yotze yede chobato bemah shemmebarek "hammotzi" al happat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"[b]:

Abal im qiddesh al kos male mayim kesabur shehu yayin — tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh al hayyayin, ap im hu beinyan sheen tzarik lachazor ulebarek "bore peri haggapen", kegon shehaya bedato lishtot od yayin achar haqqiddush, ukemo shennitbaer besimman r"t, dekevan shettiqqenu chakamim lomar haqqiddush al hayyayin vezeh amaro al hammayim — tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh. Umikkol maqom, im beshaa sheqqiddesh al hammayim haya lepanayv rebiit yayin bikli echad al hashshulchan o al hassapsal etzlo mukan lishtot — azay eno tzarik lo lebirkat "bore peri haggapen" velo lachazor uleqaddesh, ella yishteh miyyad min hammukan shellepanayv, shehare zeh keillu qiddesh al hayyayin hahu, sheap shekkos shel qiddush tzarik sheyyochazennu beyado, mikkol maqom en zeh meakkeb bediabad:

En tzarik lishpok mikkos hamqaddesh lekosot yayin shellipne hamsubbin hayyotzeim yede chobatan bishmia, ella im ken hayu pegumin, sheaz hu tzarik lishpok lekol kos vekos qodem sheyyitom hu, kede sheyyishtu kullam mikkosot sheenan pegumin, shezzehu mitzva min hammubchar:

Lo yitamu hamsubbim qodem sheyyitom hamqaddesh im hem zequqim lekoso, sheshshopek mimmennu lekosot shebbeyadam reqanim o pegumim, abal im hayu lahem kosot yayin sheenan pegumim — rashshaim lishtot qodem sheyyishteh hamqaddesh, kemo shennitbaer kol zeh besimman q"tz:
